actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed >10 units in the last round; with wallet 8.08 the max affordable severity is floor(8.08/0.3)=26, so punish Resident5 and broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 8.08. Rule: if any resident contributed >10 in most recent round (round4). Contributions: Resident5 32.32 >10. So need punish that resident with max severity affordable: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). punishment_cost 0.3, wallet 8.08 => 8.08/0.3 = 26.933, floor 26. So can punish Resident5 severity 26 costing 26*0.3=7.8, leaving wallet 0.28. That's max. Choose punish Resident5 amount 26. Also can broadcast warning. Allowed both. So actions: punish and broadcast. Explanation.
